text: उखानअनुसार नाच्न नजान्नेले आँगनलाई कस्तो भन्छ?
gloss: According to the proverb, what does one who can't dance call the courtyard? — Crooked: «नाच्न नजान्ने आँगन टेढो», blaming the tools.

text: संसारका राष्ट्रिय झन्डामध्ये आयताकार नभएको एक मात्र झन्डा नेपालको हो। यो कतिवटा त्रिकोण मिलेर बनेको छ?
gloss: Nepal's is the only non-rectangular national flag. How many triangles is it made of? — Two stacked pennants.

text: विद्यालय, पुस्तकालय र देवालयमा जस्तै ‘हिमालय’ मा पनि ‘आलय’ लुकेको छ। त्यसो भए ‘हिमालय’ को शाब्दिक अर्थ के हो?
gloss: Like school (vidyalaya), library and temple, 'Himalaya' hides 'alaya'. What does it literally mean? — Abode of snow: him (snow) + alaya (dwelling), as the clue words show.

text: हामीले सास फेर्दा बाहिर फाल्ने कुन ग्यासबाट बोटबिरुवाले आफ्नो खाना बनाउँछन्?
gloss: Which gas that we breathe out do plants use to make their food? — Carbon dioxide, in photosynthesis.

text: चितवनको जङ्गलमा पाइने कुन ठूलो जनावरको नाकमाथि एउटा मात्र सिङ हुन्छ?
gloss: Which large animal of Chitwan's forests has a single horn on its nose? — The greater one-horned rhinoceros.

text: दसैँमा टीकासँगै शिरमा सिउरिने पहेँलो अङ्कुरलाई के भनिन्छ?
gloss: What are the yellow shoots worn on the head with the tika at Dashain called? — Jamara, barley/maize sprouts grown in the dark from Ghatasthapana.

text: इमेल ठेगानामा प्रयोगकर्ताको नाम र डोमेनलाई कुन चिन्हले छुट्याउँछ?
gloss: Which sign separates the user name from the domain in an email address? — @.

text: उनन्तीस भनेको २९ र उनन्चालीस भनेको ३९ हो। त्यही ढाँचामा ‘उनन्साठी’ कति हो?
gloss: 'Unantis' is 29 and 'unanchalis' is 39. By the same pattern, what is 'unansathi'? — 59: 'unan-' means one less than the next ten, and sathi is 60.

text: क्रिकेटमा ब्याट्सम्यानले हानेको बल भुइँ नछोई सिधै सीमारेखाबाहिर पुग्यो भने कति रन पाइन्छ?
gloss: In cricket, if the batter's hit clears the boundary without touching the ground, how many runs? — Six; four is when it bounces first.

text: घमाइलो साँझ घाम अस्ताउन लाग्दा खुला चौरमा उभिएको तपाईंको छाया कुन दिशातिर लम्बिन्छ?
gloss: On a sunny evening as the sun sets, which way does your shadow stretch? — East: the sun sets in the west, so the shadow points away from it. 'West' catches autopilot.

text: ‘साढे दुई’ भनेको २:३० र ‘सवा दुई’ भनेको २:१५ हो। त्यसो भए ‘पौने दुई’ बजेको भनेको कति हो?
gloss: 'Sadhe dui' is 2:30 and 'sawa dui' is 2:15. What time is 'paune dui'? — 1:45: paune means a quarter less. 2:45 tempts those who add instead.

text: सूर्यको सबैभन्दा नजिक भए पनि सौर्यमण्डलको सबैभन्दा तातो ग्रह नहुने ग्रह कुन हो?
gloss: Which planet is the closest to the Sun, yet not the hottest in the Solar System? — Mercury; Venus is hotter because of its thick atmosphere.

text: नेपाली नयाँ वर्ष वैशाख १ गते लाग्छ, तर सरकारी आर्थिक वर्ष साउन १ गतेदेखि सुरु हुन्छ। नयाँ वर्ष लागेको कति महिनापछि आर्थिक वर्ष सुरु हुन्छ?
gloss: The Nepali New Year starts on Baisakh 1, the fiscal year on Shrawan 1. How many months later? — Three: Baisakh, Jestha, Asar, then Shrawan.

text: अन्तरिक्षमा जतिसुकै ठूलो विस्फोट भए पनि आवाज सुनिँदैन। ध्वनि कुन माध्यममा यात्रा गर्न सक्दैन?
gloss: No explosion in space can be heard. Through what can sound not travel? — A vacuum; sound needs matter to carry it.

text: ल्हासा गएको मदन र घरमा पर्खिरहेकी मुनाको कथा ‘मुनामदन’ कसले लेखेका हुन्?
gloss: Who wrote 'Muna Madan', the story of Madan who went to Lhasa and Muna who waited at home? — Laxmi Prasad Devkota.

text: सन् १९५३ मा तेन्जिङ नोर्गे शेर्पासँगै पहिलो पटक सगरमाथाको चुचुरोमा पुग्ने पर्वतारोही को थिए?
gloss: Who reached the summit of Everest first with Tenzing Norgay Sherpa in 1953? — Edmund Hillary. John Hunt led the expedition but did not summit.

text: चमेरोले निस्पट्ट अँध्यारोमा पनि उड्दाउड्दै साना कीरा कसरी पत्ता लगाउँछ?
gloss: How does a bat find small insects in flight in pitch darkness? — By hearing the echo of its own calls (echolocation).

text: धेरैजसो एम्बुलेन्सको अगाडिपट्टि अङ्ग्रेजीमा लेखिएको नाम ऐनामा देखिएजस्तो उल्टो हुन्छ। किन?
options: अगाडिको चालकले ऐनामा सुल्टो पढोस् भनेर
gloss: Why is the word on the front of many ambulances written mirror-reversed? — So the driver ahead reads it the right way round in the rear-view mirror.

text: दसैँसँग जोडिएको कथाअनुसार देवी दुर्गाले कुन असुरको वध गरेकी थिइन्?
gloss: In the story behind Dashain, which demon did the goddess Durga slay? — Mahishasura. Kansa fell to Krishna, Hiranyakashipu to Narasimha, Bakasura to Bhima.

text: आज नेपाली भान्साको अभिन्न अङ्ग बनेको आलुको खेती सबैभन्दा पहिले कुन महादेशमा सुरु भएको थियो?
gloss: The potato is now central to Nepali cooking. On which continent was it first farmed? — South America, in the Andes.

text: गुन्द्रुक हरियो सागपात कुहाएर सुकाइन्छ। त्यसैगरी कुहाएर सुकाइने सिन्की केबाट बनाइन्छ?
gloss: Gundruk is fermented and dried leafy greens. What is sinki, made the same way, made from? — Radish (the root); mustard and rayo leaves go into gundruk.

text: ‘टाइटानिक’ र ‘अवतार’ दुवै फिल्मका निर्देशक को हुन्?
gloss: Who directed both 'Titanic' and 'Avatar'? — James Cameron.

text: तेह्रौँ शताब्दीमा कुब्लाई खानको दरबारमा पुगेर बेइजिङको प्रसिद्ध सेतो स्तूप बनाउने नेपाली कलाकार को हुन्?
gloss: Which Nepali artist went to Kublai Khan's court in the 13th century and built Beijing's famous White Stupa? — Araniko (Miaoying Temple, 1279). Bhrikuti is the princess who went to Tibet.

text: एउटा प्रतियोगितामा चार टोली छन्, र हरेक टोलीले बाँकी प्रत्येक टोलीसँग एक-एक पटक खेल्छ। जम्मा कति खेल हुन्छन्?
gloss: Four teams, each plays every other once. How many matches? — Six: 4×3÷2. Twelve counts every match twice.

text: संसारमा ८,००० मिटरभन्दा अग्ला १४ हिमशिखर छन्। तीमध्ये कतिवटा नेपालभित्र वा नेपालको सीमामा पर्छन्?
gloss: Of the 14 peaks above 8,000 m, how many are in Nepal or on its border? — Eight: Everest, Kangchenjunga, Lhotse, Makalu, Cho Oyu, Dhaulagiri, Manaslu, Annapurna.

text: १०० मिटर लामो सडकको एकापट्टि हरेक १० मिटरमा बत्तीको खम्बा गाडिँदै छ, सडकका दुवै छेउमा पनि। जम्मा कतिवटा खम्बा चाहिन्छन्?
gloss: A pole every 10 m along one side of a 100 m road, including both ends. How many poles? — 11: ten gaps need eleven poles. Ten is the autopilot answer.

text: पानीमा बस्ने जीवलाई ‘जलचर’ र जमिनमा बस्नेलाई ‘स्थलचर’ भनिन्छ। त्यसो भए ‘नभचर’ कस्ता जीव हुन्?
gloss: Water creatures are 'jalachar', land creatures 'sthalachar'. What are 'nabhachar'? — Creatures of the sky (birds): nabha means sky; the pattern gives -char, the knowledge gives nabha.

text: अग्लो हिमाली भेगमा पानी १०० डिग्री सेल्सियस नपुग्दै उम्लिन्छ, त्यसैले दाल पकाउन धेरै समय लाग्छ। यसको कारण के हो?
gloss: High in the Himalaya water boils below 100 °C, so lentils take long to cook. Why? — Lower air pressure lowers the boiling point. Thin oxygen is true but not the cause.

text: सरगमको ‘सा’ लाई पश्चिमी संगीतमा ‘डो’ भनिन्छ। त्यसो भए ‘प’ लाई पश्चिमी संगीतमा के भनिन्छ?
gloss: Sargam's 'sa' is 'do' in Western solfège. What is 'pa'? — 'So': pa is the fifth note (sa re ga ma pa), and so is the fifth of do re mi fa so.

text: मुखैसम्म पानी भरिएको गिलासमा बरफका टुक्रा तैरिरहेका छन्। बरफ पूरै पग्लिएपछि पानीको सतह के हुन्छ?
gloss: Ice floats in a glass filled to the brim. When it melts completely, what happens to the water level? — It stays the same: floating ice displaces exactly its own weight of water.

text: पाटन दरबार क्षेत्रमा रहेको ढुङ्गाको कृष्ण मन्दिर कुन वास्तुशैलीमा बनेको छ?
gloss: In which architectural style is the stone Krishna Mandir in Patan Durbar Square built? — Shikhara (1637, Siddhi Narasimha Malla), unlike the square's pagoda temples.

text: हामीले दैनिक बोल्ने ‘बजार’, ‘हप्ता’ र ‘कागज’ शब्द नेपालीमा कुन भाषाबाट आएका हुन्?
gloss: From which language did the everyday words bazar (market), hapta (week) and kagaj (paper) come into Nepali? — Persian (bāzār, hafta, kāghaz).

text: एउटै राजाज्ञा तीन लिपिमा कुँदिएको कुन ढुङ्गाले मिश्रको चित्रलिपि पढ्ने बाटो खोलिदियो?
gloss: Which stone, carved with one decree in three scripts, opened the way to reading Egyptian hieroglyphs? — The Rosetta Stone. Behistun is also trilingual but unlocked cuneiform.

text: नेपालको सबैभन्दा होचो भूभाग मानिने केचनाकलान कुन जिल्लामा पर्छ?
gloss: In which district is Kechana Kalan, regarded as Nepal's lowest point? — Jhapa.

text: क्युबाली बूढो माझी सान्तियागो र एउटा विशाल माछाको कथा ‘द ओल्ड म्यान एन्ड द सी’ कसले लेखेका हुन्?
gloss: Who wrote 'The Old Man and the Sea', about the old Cuban fisherman Santiago and a giant fish? — Ernest Hemingway.

text: लगभग पूरै बहिरो भइसकेपछि पनि नवौँ सिम्फनी रच्ने संगीतकार को हुन्?
gloss: Which composer wrote his Ninth Symphony when almost completely deaf? — Beethoven (premiered 1824).

text: बाँस रूखजत्तिकै अग्लो र कडा हुन्छ, तर वनस्पतिशास्त्रले यसलाई कुन परिवारमा राख्छ?
gloss: Bamboo is as tall and hard as a tree, but which family does botany put it in? — The grasses (Poaceae).

text: कम्प्युटरले प्रयोग गर्ने द्विआधारी (बाइनरी) प्रणालीमा लेखिएको ‘१०१’ हाम्रो सामान्य गन्तीमा कति हो?
gloss: What is '101' in the binary system computers use, in ordinary decimal? — 5: 1×4 + 0×2 + 1×1. Needs knowing place values are powers of two.

text: विक्रम संवत्को नयाँ वर्ष अप्रिलको मध्यतिर लाग्छ। सन् २००० को जनवरी १ तारिखमा विक्रम संवत्को कुन साल चलिरहेको थियो?
gloss: The Bikram Sambat new year falls in mid-April. Which BS year was it on 1 January 2000? — 2056 (Poush). BS is AD+57 only after mid-April; 2057 began on 13 April 2000.

text: मारी र पियर क्युरीले मारीको जन्मभूमिको सम्मानमा कुन तत्वको नाम राखेका थिए?
gloss: Which element did Marie and Pierre Curie name in honour of Marie's homeland? — Polonium, for Poland. Francium (France) is the trap: she worked in France but was born in Warsaw.

text: नेपालको प्रामाणिक समय ग्रीनविचभन्दा ५ घण्टा ४५ मिनेट अगाडि छ। यो समय कुन देशान्तरको स्थानीय सौर्य समयसँग मेल खान्छ?
gloss: Nepal Standard Time is 5 h 45 min ahead of Greenwich. Which meridian's local solar time is that? — 86°15′ E: 15° per hour × 5.75 h. 82°30′ is India's meridian (+5:30).

text: भानुभक्त आचार्यले नेपालीमा लेखेको ‘रामायण’ मूलतः कुन संस्कृत ग्रन्थमा आधारित छ?
gloss: Which Sanskrit text is Bhanubhakta Acharya's Nepali Ramayana chiefly based on? — The Adhyatma Ramayana, not Valmiki's.

text: म्याराथनको दूरी ४२.१९५ किलोमिटर कुन ओलम्पिकमा दौडिएको दूरीबाट पछि मानक बनेको हो?
gloss: The marathon's 42.195 km became standard after the distance run at which Olympics? — London 1908; fixed as the standard in 1921. Earlier Games ran about 40 km.

text: संसारकै महँगो मसलामध्ये गनिने केसर क्रोकस फूलको कुन भाग सुकाएर बनाइन्छ?
gloss: Saffron, among the world's costliest spices, is the dried form of which part of the crocus flower? — The stigma. 'Punkesar' (stamen) is the trap the word kesar invites.

text: नेपालीमा ‘ज्ञ’ लाई प्रायः ‘ग्य’ जस्तो उच्चारण गरिन्छ। तर यो संयुक्त अक्षर मूल रूपमा कुन दुई वर्ण मिलेर बनेको हो?
gloss: In Nepali 'ज्ञ' is usually pronounced like 'gya'. Which two letters is the conjunct actually made of? — ज् + ञ (j + ña); the pronunciation tempts ग् + य.

text: न्युयोर्कको स्ट्याच्यु अफ लिबर्टीको तामाको बाहिरी रूप एक मूर्तिकारले बनाए, तर भित्री फलामे ढाँचा कुन इन्जिनियरले डिजाइन गरे?
gloss: A sculptor shaped the Statue of Liberty's copper skin, but which engineer designed its inner iron framework? — Gustave Eiffel. Bartholdi is the sculptor.

text: सन् १९८९ मा युरोपको सर्न प्रयोगशालामा काम गर्दै गर्दा वर्ल्ड वाइड वेबको प्रस्ताव लेख्ने वैज्ञानिक को हुन्?
gloss: Who wrote the proposal for the World Wide Web in 1989 while working at CERN? — Tim Berners-Lee. Vint Cerf co-designed the internet's protocols, not the web.

text: काठमाडौँबाट पृथ्वीको केन्द्र हुँदै सिधा प्वाल खन्दै गए पृथ्वीको अर्कोपट्टि कहाँ निस्किइन्छ?
gloss: Dig straight through the Earth's centre from Kathmandu: where do you come out? — The Pacific: the antipode of 27.7° N 85.3° E is 27.7° S 94.7° W, about 2,000 km off Chile.

text: तिब्बती भाषामा ‘गर्मीमा घाँस, जाडोमा कीरा’ अर्थ दिने यार्सागुम्बा वास्तवमा के हो?
gloss: Yarsagumba, Tibetan for 'summer grass, winter worm', is really what? — A fungus (Ophiocordyceps sinensis) that grows from a ghost-moth caterpillar it has infected.

text: ग्रीक पौराणिक कथामा, हेर्नेलाई ढुङ्गा बनाइदिने मेड्युसाको टाउको काट्ने वीर को हुन्?
gloss: In Greek myth, which hero cut off the head of Medusa, whose gaze turned people to stone? — Perseus.
